title: Combining Relevant Expert Knowledge Using Mixtures of Feedback Fuzzy Cognitive Maps
abstract: arXiv:2611.05664v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A neuro-symbolic system should combine only relevant answers from expert agents or other knowledge sources. Using only relevant experts for a given input query becomes ever more important for accuracy and scalability as the knowledge network grows and connects ever more knowledge sources. We extend the standard definition of relevance from the legal theory of evidence: An answer is relevant if and only if it is both probative and material for the matter at hand given the knowledge available. We apply this relevancy scheme to mixing the feedback fuzzy cognitive maps (FCMs) of real or artificial experts. The expert FCM directed causal graphs mix or combine into a common knowledge network. We compare the equilibrium limit-cycle predictions or answers of the experts to the answers of the mixture FCM and then estimate the probative status of answers by their difference or variation. translated_title: 使用反馈模糊认知图混合体组合相关专家知识
translated_abstract: 神经符号系统应当只组合来自专家智能体或其他知识源的相关答案。随着知识网络的不断增长并连接越来越多的知识源，针对给定输入查询仅使用相关专家对于准确性和可扩展性变得愈发重要。我们从证据法理论出发扩展了相关性的标准定义：在给定可用知识的条件下，当且仅当一个答案对于手头问题既具有证明力又具有实质性时，该答案才是相关的。我们将这一相关性方案应用于混合真实或人工专家的反馈模糊认知图（FCMs）。各专家FCM的有向因果图混合或组合成一个共同的知识网络。我们将专家的均衡极限环预测或答案与混合FCM的答案进行比较，然后通过它们之间的差异或变化来估计答案的证明力状态。一个新的类贝叶斯定理将知识混合物解混合为……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将法律证据理论中的相关性定义扩展应用于神经符号系统，通过将专家的反馈模糊认知图混合为共同知识网络，并借助新的类贝叶斯定理对混合知识进行解混合，从而仅组合相关专家答案以提升系统的准确性和可扩展性。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the legal-theory definition of relevance to neuro-symbolic systems by mixing experts' feedback fuzzy cognitive maps into a common knowledge network and using a new Bayes-like theorem to de-mix the knowledge, so that only relevant expert answers are combined to improve accuracy and scalability.
